claim: Diagnostic recordings of a synthetic, population-scaled athlete-barbell model integrated by MuJoCo. Not validated against measured human motion, not subject-specific, not sealed DynamisBench evidence and not a benchmark execution.

recordings.label: Back squat — nominal
recordings.description: One controlled repetition at parallel depth, dt 1 ms: standing, descent, bottom, ascent, standing. Motion integrated from actuator torques.

recordings.label: Timestep study — dt 0.5 ms
recordings.description: The same repetition at half the timestep: the convergence companion of the nominal.

recordings.label: Ablation — no internal model
recordings.description: The controller predicts only static torques: every inertial effect must be caught by feedback. Shown to demonstrate what the checks reject.

recordings.label: Ablation — soft friction
recordings.description: Sole friction at the 15 ms normal-contact time constant (the model before the repetition was built). Shown to demonstrate what the checks reject.
